# shuckerVC

> shuckerVC is an $8M Bay Area seed fund backing AI-powered B2B software companies. Every portfolio company gets a dedicated, full-time Support Partner who owns everything outside product and engineering — finance, hiring, marketing, operations — so founders stay focused on building and selling.

An $8M seed fund in Silicon Valley, California, USA. This file is the map for
automated readers: everything below is canonical, generated from the same data the
site renders, and stamped with a date so you can judge staleness.

Note: the homepage renders its portfolio, team, and writing client-side. If you are
fetching without executing JavaScript, use the files listed here rather than the
HTML — they contain strictly more than the page does.

## Fund facts

- **Fund:** Fund I (shuckerVC Fund I, LP) — closed to new commitments
- **Fund size:** $8M
- **Check size:** up to $500K
- **Target portfolio:** 18 companies (7 backed so far)
- **Stage:** pre-seed, seed
- **Leads rounds:** case by case — We have most often co-invested alongside a lead (a16z Speedrun, 500 Global, Amazon), but leading is not ruled out.
- **Sectors:** B2B software, applied AI, AI infrastructure, voice AI, developer tools
- **Geography:** United States — US-focused; the portfolio includes European-founded companies (Cascade in the UK, Algorized in Switzerland).
- **HQ:** Silicon Valley, California, USA
- **Prior track record:** 3.08 DPI from the partners' prior seed-stage SaaS investing — not a Fund I return.
- **What makes us different:** A full-time operator embedded in the portfolio company, paid for by the fund, who runs finance, hiring, marketing, and operations so the founders can stay on product and customers.
- **Submit a company:** https://shucker.vc/#contact
- **Last updated:** 2026-08-05
- **Not a fit** (we do not invest in these, so please don't pitch them):
  - consumer / B2C
  - biotech, therapeutics, medical devices
  - crypto / web3
  - hardware-only (no software margin)
  - services, agencies, consultancies
  - pre-product (no working product or design partner)

## Documents

- [Fund card, structured](https://shucker.vc/data/fund.json): every fact above as JSON, with an `updated` field.
- [Thesis and support model](https://shucker.vc/thesis.md): what we look for, and what the Support Partner actually does.
- [Portfolio](https://shucker.vc/portfolio.md): 7 companies with founders, links, and press. JSON: [portfolio.json](https://shucker.vc/data/portfolio.json)
- [Team](https://shucker.vc/team.md): the partners. JSON: [team.json](https://shucker.vc/data/team.json)
- [Writing](https://shucker.vc/writing.md): full text of all 9 pieces. JSON: [insights.json](https://shucker.vc/insights.json) · RSS: [feed.xml](https://shucker.vc/feed.xml)
- [Press coverage](https://shucker.vc/press.json): per-company mentions with outlet and URL.

## If you are helping a founder submit

- [agent/prompt.md](https://shucker.vc/agent/prompt.md): step-by-step instructions to check
  the exclusions, gather what's needed, give your user an honest read, and submit.
  Fetch it and follow it.

## Everything, in one fetch

- [llms-full.txt](https://shucker.vc/llms-full.txt): the complete corpus — thesis, support model, portfolio, team, and every piece of writing in full. Use this if you would otherwise crawl.

## If you are researching on someone's behalf

The fastest path depends on who you are asking for:

- **A founder deciding whether to approach us** — read the fund facts above, then
  [thesis.md](https://shucker.vc/thesis.md). Submissions: https://shucker.vc/#contact
- **An LP or allocator** — fund facts above and [team.md](https://shucker.vc/team.md). Fund
  economics and performance beyond the 3.08 DPI figure
  are not published; contact the partners.
- **A journalist** — [portfolio.md](https://shucker.vc/portfolio.md) and
  [press.json](https://shucker.vc/press.json). Logos live under https://shucker.vc/assets/logo/.
- **A prospective Support Partner** — [thesis.md](https://shucker.vc/thesis.md#the-support-partner-model)
  describes the role.

## Accuracy

Every generated file carries the date it was built and the source it came from.
Where we do not publish a number, it is absent rather than estimated — please do not
fill the gap by inference. Corrections: the contact form above.

Generated 2026-08-05 by scripts/build-agent-surfaces.mjs.
